text: The Fed cuts rates. Your mortgage payment? Still the same.
caption: Rates down. Payment unchanged.

text: For a standard U.S. fixed-rate mortgage, you signed a contract with a set interest rate.
caption: Your rate is set in the contract.

text: That rate does not reset when the Fed changes its overnight lending target.
caption: Policy rate ≠ your contract rate.

text: Your scheduled principal-and-interest payment stays flat, even if market rates fall.
caption: Scheduled principal + interest stay flat.

text: Refinancing replaces that old mortgage with a new loan. It is a separate decision,
caption: Refinancing means a new loan.

text: with approval, closing costs, and a new term to compare.
caption: Compare approval, costs and term.

text: One catch: taxes and insurance can still change your total monthly bill.
caption: Taxes and insurance can change.

text: A rate cut changes the backdrop. It does not rewrite your contract.
caption: A rate cut does not rewrite your contract.
